text: Men nulirii ma an Nulaaɗo, seedoytooɗo e mofte maa ɗen Ñalnde Darngal, e wewlinoowo gomɗimɓe ɓen, ballal poolal ngal Allah marani ɓe ngal aduna, e neema mo O marani ɓe on laakara. Men Nulirmaa kadi hulɓinoroowo heeferɓe ɓen, koyeera e fooleede ko O fodi kon gomɗimɓe ɓen huuway e maɓɓe aduna, e lepte muusuɗe ɗe O hebilani ɓe ɗen laakara, hino habbitiiɓe.
